name: Outlet Shopping
summary: Outlet Shopping is a value-focused retail center on San Antonio's Fredericksburg Road, offering shoppers access to discounted brand-name merchandise. With a 4.4-star rating and convenient hours until 8:30 PM, it serves as a popular destination for bargain hunters throughout the metro area.
demographics: Outlet Shopping attracts a diverse mix of budget-conscious shoppers and bargain hunters from across the San Antonio metropolitan area, with a strong representation of middle-income families and value-seeking millennials. The center draws from a broad trade area extending beyond the immediate Fredericksburg Road corridor, appealing to shoppers aged 25-55 who prioritize discounted brand-name merchandise. The location in the Wonderland of the Americas area serves a multicultural customer base reflective of San Antonio's demographics, with visitors typically making planned shopping trips specifically for deals and discounts rather than convenience-based visits.
description: Outlet Shopping is a value-oriented retail destination located at 4522 Fredericksburg Road in San Antonio's Wonderland of the Americas district. This outlet center provides shoppers with access to discounted brand-name merchandise and factory-direct pricing, making it a popular destination for bargain hunters throughout the San Antonio area. With a solid 4.4-star rating from 142 reviews, visitors consistently praise the center as an "awesome place to shop" with "pretty decent stores." The center maintains convenient operating hours from 10:00 AM to 8:30 PM, accommodating both weekday and weekend shoppers. Its location along the busy Fredericksburg Road corridor provides easy accessibility for residents across San Antonio and surrounding communities seeking quality merchandise at outlet prices.
